messages:
harper k: follow-up from last night's noisy redis spike. want clear owners and short ETAs so we stop seeing the same pattern during weekday quiet hours.
harper k: quick summary: shard rebalancer + short cache TTLs triggered repeated alerts. paging amplified because alerts fire on 1m spikes during quiet-window, waking oncall. proposed small set of fixes below.
harper k: fixes i suggest (tiny and incremental):
  1) add quiet-hours gating: suppress pagers for severity=warning between 00:00-07:00 local unless sustained >3m
  2) tighten dedupe keys: use stable shard+zone instead of instance, add a lint rule
  3) add per-rule repage backoff (10m) for high-cardinality rules
  4) run a 72h noise-heatmap after deploy and share short deck
please claim an item + ETA (date or "today EOD").
ivan d: i'll take 2. will replace any `instance` templates with `shard:zone` and add a linter check to CI. ETA: Wed EOD (2025-02-12).
zara_m: i'll take 1 and 3 together. plan: implement quiet-hours gating in routing and add `repage_block: 10m` annotation to shard rules. i'll open two small PRs. ETA: tomorrow AM (2025-02-11).
leo: i'll own 4. will run noise-heatmap job after the flips and publish top-10 noisy rules + tenant buckets at 24/72h. ETA: monitor kicks off after deploy; summary at +24h.
ops-bot: Silence set by zara_m for #pager-duty from 2025-02-11T00:15Z until 2025-02-11T07:00Z for rollout testing.
ivan d: small diff idea for dedupe lint: `alert_labels must not include instance` -> fail CI with link to migration doc.
zara_m: routing snippet i'll propose:
```yaml
routing:
  - match: severity == "warning" and window between 00:00..07:00
    action: route_to_ops_queue unless sustained_for > 180s
```
leo: after deploy i'll run `./ops/noise_monitor --window 72h --rules redis-*` and paste charts.
harper k: excellent. please each drop a one-line ETA for the PM tracker so i can mark owners.
ivan d: ETA Wed EOD (2025-02-12) - PR + linter.
zara_m: ETA 2025-02-11 AM - routing + repage change PRs.
leo: ETA monitor summary posted 24h after deploy; full 72h at +72h.
harper k: i'll update the postmortem with these owners and set a 15m sync next Fri to confirm closure. any blockers?
ivan d: none.
zara_m: infra gave staging capacity for replays, no blockers.
leo: no blockers.
harper k: thanks everyone :thumbsup: i'll close the loop here and reopen if things drift.
